basic_details.job_title: Office of the Health Officer, Diu Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 6 Gynecologist, Physician and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Office of the Health Officer, Diu (UT Administration of Dadra & Nagar Haveli & Daman & Diu) is accepting applications until 23 November 2026 for six specialist doctor posts. Applications go by email to [email protected] or by post to the Office of The Health Officer, CHC Ghoghla-Diu 362540. The interview will be held at NAMO Hospital Daman, Nani Daman or at Seva Bhavan/ Collectorate, Diu, and eligible candidates will be told the interview date. how_to_apply: Prepare a copy of your bio-data.
Attach self-attested copies of your Graduation and Post Graduation Degree and your registration certificates.
Send the application to the email ID [email protected], or by post to Office of The Health Officer, CHC Ghoghla-Diu 362540.
Make sure the application is sent by 23 November 2026.
Wait for the office to tell eligible candidates the interview date.
Choose your interview venue: NAMO Hospital Daman, Nani Daman, or Seva Bhavan/ Collectorate, Diu.
Self-attested copy of Post Graduation Degree
important_instructions: Specialists need to be available on call as and when required for the smooth functioning of the Health Department. Residence at headquarters is compulsory in public interest. Specialists can leave headquarters only after due approval of the respective Head of Office. An undertaking has to be given that the specialist will not do any private practice. No T.A / D.A or any other claim shall be paid for attending the interview. For queries, the notice prints the office telephone number 02875-252244.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: All six posts are listed "Under NHM Scheme". They share the same qualification, pay and age limit: MBBS with PG Degree/Diploma and 3 years' experience with valid registration, Rs. 2,00,000/- per month, and an age limit of 62 yrs. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the posts. Essential: MBBS with PG Degree/Diploma & 3 years' experience with valid registration. The candidate having less experience may also attend the interview. The candidate must possess Graduate/ Master/ PG Degree/ PG Diploma & Valid Registration compulsory. The age limit printed for all six posts is 62 yrs. The notice does not give a date for counting age. Age relaxation may be considered for Specialists by the Competent authority. Candidates having domicile certificate of U.T. of DNH, Daman & Diu will be given preference. Candidates from elsewhere are not barred by the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the post-wise eligibility of each specialist post.

content_sections.heading: Salary and Contract Terms
content_sections.text: All the posts are purely on contract basis up to 31/03/2027 under NHM Scheme. If the scheme continues, the contract will be extended based on performance appraisal or till the posts are filled up on a regular basis. The engagement is on contract basis till regular posts are filled up, whichever is earlier. The notice does not mention any allowance on top of the remuneration.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Diu Health Department Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are invited till 23/11/2026, by email to [email protected] or by post to the Office of The Health Officer, CHC Ghoghla-Diu 362540.

faq.question: Q2. When is the walk-in interview for the Diu specialist posts?
faq.answer: The notice does not fix an interview date. It says the date of interview shall be communicated to the eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. Where will the interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be held either at NAMO Hospital Daman, Nani Daman, or at Seva Bhavan/ Collectorate, Diu. Candidates may opt for Daman or Diu.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are there in the Diu Health Department Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 posts, one each of Gynecologist, Dermatologist, Orthopedic, Physician, Ger. Surgeon and Psychiatrist, under the NHM Scheme.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is required for the Diu specialist posts?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is MBBS with PG Degree/Diploma and 3 years' experience with valid registration. A candidate with less experience may also attend the interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Diu specialist posts?
faq.answer: The age limit printed for all posts is 62 yrs. Age relaxation may be considered for Specialists by the Competent authority.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of a specialist in the Diu Health Department?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 2,00,000/- per month for each of the six posts.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents must be sent with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must send a copy of their bio-data, with self-attested copies of their Graduation and Post Graduation Degree and their registration certificates attached.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Diu specialist doctor job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely on contract basis up to 31/03/2027 under the NHM Scheme. If the scheme continues, the contract will be extended based on performance appraisal or till the posts are filled up on a regular basis.

faq.question: Q10. Can selected specialists do private practice?
faq.answer: No. Selected specialists must give an undertaking that they will not do any private practice. They must also live at headquarters and be available on call.
